aliases.name: Volatile Kitten
aliases.analyst_notes: CrowdStrike tracks VOLATILE KITTEN as an Iran-based actor/development team associated with Shamoon. ETDA Threat Group Cards maps Greenbug and Volatile Kitten together.

actor.description: Greenbug / Volatile Kitten is an Iran-linked threat cluster. CrowdStrike tracks VOLATILE KITTEN as a state-sponsored Iran-based development team associated with Shamoon; ETDA Threat Group Cards maps Greenbug and Volatile Kitten together.
actor.analyst_notes: Shamoon is modeled separately as malware; the old Shamoon actor entity is deprecated. CrowdStrike's state-sponsored classification applies to VOLATILE KITTEN. Because the Greenbug-to-Volatile-Kitten name mapping remains overlapping rather than exact, Greenbug retains only the neutral threat-cluster actor type and a medium-confidence state-aligned attribution.

attribution.assessment: CrowdStrike describes VOLATILE KITTEN as an Iran-based state-sponsored adversary; ETDA maps Greenbug/Volatile Kitten and lists Iranian state sponsorship.
attribution.analyst_notes: State-aligned is used conservatively because the vendor/aggregate sources describe sponsorship but cluster boundaries remain vendor-specific.

diamond_model.analyst_notes: Legacy source-unbound prose was cleared in the 2026-09 evidence audit; use evidence-linked activity-level Diamond models.

malware.name: Shamoon
malware.description: CrowdStrike tracks VOLATILE KITTEN as a development team associated with Shamoon.
malware.analyst_notes: Association does not mean every Shamoon deployment is Greenbug / Volatile Kitten activity.
